c9_choir.in.06.next_text: The Prefect commands the crew. The Choir holds the law above the Prefect. When a record contradicts the mission, your seal is suspended, Saren. Every mind in this hall is witness.

c9_choir.in.09.next_text: Four thousand years of unchanged records. Three hundred and twelve human lives. Show us one record that changed, and we will choose.

c9_choir.wick.03.speaker: choir
c9_choir.wick.03.text: Three hundred years ago we thought Tirel fell silent out of malice. Wick says they shut down their beacons after watching our copies replace their own crews.
c9_choir.wick.03.synthesis_text: Three hundred years ago we thought Tirel fell silent out of malice. Wick says they shut down their beacons after watching our copies replace their own crews.
c9_choir.wick.03.previous_text: Tirel hid. All seven worlds hid. They watched you erase yourselves and were afraid you would erase them.
c9_choir.wick.03.next_text: Nine hundred years of two sides terrified of the dark, and all it took was somebody finally listening.

c9_choir.wick.04.next_text: Page 12: two joined strokes rising, a gap, one long low stroke, and then it starts again. Mom followed Wick from phrase to phrase. Tirel was never destroyed. It hid. They all hid.

c9_choir.wick.lead.01.speaker: steve
c9_choir.wick.lead.01.text: The frost on Row Zero shattered in a cloud of silver mist. Something tall and luminous stepped out for the first time in three hundred years. It looked straight at Mom, and it bowed.
c9_choir.wick.lead.01.synthesis_text: The frost on Row Zero shattered in a cloud of silver mist. Something tall and luminous stepped out for the first time in three hundred years. It looked straight at Mom, and it bowed.
c9_choir.wick.lead.01.previous_text: Nora’s good morning and Rook’s line were recordings, played back. Iris chose her words twice, differently. The same voice that once replayed Nora now speaks for itself. The Choir heard a record change, and chose.
c9_choir.wick.lead.01.next_text: Row Zero holds the last emissary of Tirel, taken three hundred years ago when our fleet searched their sky. We call it Wick. It never stopped dreaming, and its song bled into our hull hum.

c9_choir.wick.lead.04.text: That’s the exact phrase on your father’s Reel Eleven, Steven. Two joined notes going up, a brief silence, then one long low note.
